title: metadata-protocol: after hydration, the first holder's exact address of a doc two packages ship serves the environment's package-less row instead of that package's own doc
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5obaLbqgzRUR9xXfft

Filing gate: ① reproducible defect (class a), measured. Found by area o1-D's dev on PR #34347 (out-of-scope finding in dev report 6920924279 on #34247). Reader who acts: the server lane, after #34347 lands (it touches the same reads).

## Symptom

An environment saves a package-less doc `N` while no package ships it; later packages A and B, which both ship `N`, are installed. After a restart (boot hydration), or after `loadMetaFromDb` runs once the artifacts are registered, `GET /meta/doc/N?package=A` (A registered first) answers 200 with the environment row's content, not A's own doc. The bare doors answer 409 naming both holders. A reader who asks for A's doc gets the environment's text under A's name.

## Location

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-bindings.ts#mergeArtifactProtection` grafts the first registered holder's envelope onto the environment row's body (`_packageId` = the first holder, `_provenance: 'package'`), so the registry's entry at A's address is the environment row.

## How it was found

Measured on the composed artifact rig, dispatcher and RestServer, both registration orders, at `origin/main` `c9346317` and at #34347's earlier head `72dc8ca2`; unchanged by #34347 (which pins this state as a CONTROL).

reach: `GET /api/v1/meta/doc/:name?package=:firstHolder` on a deployment with a hydrated package-less row of a name two packages ship. Measured.

## Acceptance

1. In that state, `?package=A` serves A's own doc and `?package=B` serves B's, in both registration orders, on the plain read, `/layers` and `/published`; the environment row stays reachable at its own (package-less / `_env`) address.
2. The bare doors' answers are unchanged (409 naming both, per ruling 6893582352 and #34347).
3. CONTROLs: hydration before the artifacts (the case #34347 pins), one holder only, no environment row.
4. Declaration: the exact address moves from the environment row's content to the holder's own doc. `Clause-②:` as the measured FROM→TO reads (expected `no (narrowing)` with an ADR-0087 entry if any door that answered 200 now answers differently).

## Related

#34247, #34248 and PR #34347; #33127 (stored rows after a restart, different shape); #32568 (closed: package-less item at both exact addresses, draft and preview doors); ADR-0150 D3/D5.

Dedupe: `is:issue mergeArtifactProtection package-less row exact address` → 4 hits (#34247, #28409 closed, #31699 closed, #6015), none on this shape; `is:issue hydrate graft envelope first holder doc` → 18 hits, top 5 read (#34247, #33127, #31527, #32568 closed, #33385 closed), none on this shape.
